# Recommended exercises by topic {.unnumbered}

This chapter contains lists of mathematics exercises grouped by each
quantum chemistry topic taught at the school. These exercises can be
useful as a warm-up to the proper exercises given each day.

## Coupled-cluster theory {.unnumbered}

### Beginner {.unnumbered}

- @exr-taylor-exp — Approximating the exponential function
- @exr-matrix-exponential-diagonal — Exponential of a diagonal matrix
- @exr-matrix-exponential-simple-nilpotent — An exponential whose series terminates

### Intermediate {.unnumbered}

- @exr-taylor-matrix-exponential — From the exponential to rotations
- @exr-exponential-rotation — A matrix exponential and rotations
- @exr-hadamard-terminating — A terminating similarity transformation

## Second quantization {.unnumbered}

### Beginner {.unnumbered}

- @exr-summing-1 — Very basic sums
- @exr-summing-2 — Simplifying as a sum
- @exr-summing-4 — Reconstruct a vector
- @exr-summing-dummy-index — The summation index is a dummy index
- @exr-summing-linearity — Linearity of sums
- @exr-summing-constant — When something does not depend on the summation index
- @exr-summing-free-index — Free and summed indices
- @exr-summing-reindexing — Shifting the summation index
- @exr-kronecker-delta — The Kronecker delta: basic exercise
- @exr-combinatorics-binomial-coefficients — Basic binomial coefficients
- @exr-combinatorics-binomial-theorem-basic — The binomial theorem

### Intermediate {.unnumbered}

- @exr-combinatorics-binomial-theorem-coefficients — Coefficients in binomial expansions
- @exr-complex-power-series-exponential-sine-cosine — The exponential, sine, and cosine series
